messages:
emma_sales: Customer (Clearhaven) confirmed they want a 2-week POC for Private deployment. Must use PrivateLink for control plane and either static egress IPs or proxy-auth for outbound. They need: firewall allowlist, confirmation of CMK support, and a rough cost delta vs Hosted. Adding @ryan_platform and @nina_netops.

ryan_platform: We support customer-managed CMKs for Private. For static egress we can allocate 2 Elastic IPs per region tied to the NAT appliance on Dedicated. Recommend static EIPs to avoid proxy auth complexity.

nina_netops: Example allowlist snippet for their firewall/proxy: 
```
ALLOW TCP 443 TO 52.24.34.10,52.24.34.11  # control-plane EIPs us-east-1
ALLOW TCP 8443 TO 52.24.34.20             # runtime EIP (dedicated)
DNS: allow outbound to their resolver or 8.8.8.8 for FQDN resolution
```
We will replace with final EIPs before kickoff. Also note: if their proxy does TLS MITM, they must trust our client cert or we should use NAT EIPs.

ryan_platform: Pricing (ballpark for 14 days): one-time setup $1,200; Dedicated prorated ~$1,800; EIP/NAT appliance prorated ~$250. Suggest offering a flat POC bundle: $3,000. Will refine if they share expected token/GB numbers.

ops-bot: Reminder: attach SOC2 summary and runbook when sending to security.

emma_sales: I'll send questionnaire and ask whether they prefer NAT EIPs or proxy-auth. Action items: ryan to finalize quote (24h), nina to produce final EIP list and formal firewall doc (24h). Will report back. :thumbsup:
